title: US Stock Futures Fall on AI Warning, Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
summary: US equity futures fell and oil advanced as investors weighed renewed concerns over the pace of AI development against hotter-than-expected US inflation that bolstered bets the Federal Reserve may raise interest rates on Wednesday.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 14
summary: Oil advanced after Saudi Arabia shut a major crude pipeline following attacks, disrupting a route that’s been used to bypass the Strait of Hormuz during the US-Iran war and deepening a global energy crunch.

title: Hormuz Meeting With Iran and Gulf Nations Delayed, Oman Says
summary: A planned meeting for Monday between Iran and several Gulf nations on creating a temporary shipping lane through the Strait of Hormuz has been postponed, according to Oman’s foreign minister.

title: A 5% Treasury Yield Is Raising New Risks for Markets, Economy
summary: The bond selloff has driven a key Treasury yield to the verge of 5%, worsening angst from Wall Street to Washington about the higher borrowing costs hitting the US economy.
